issue.title: [1.15 Hotfix] Port three war-goal overrides to current enforcement and infamy rules
issue.body:
## Classification and priority
**Static divergence confirmed; broken gameplay not yet reproduced. P1, escalate if a representative conflict fails.** Parent #22; dependencies #21; coordination #19.

## Affected files and evidence
- `common/war_goal_types/00_annex_country.txt` lacks vanilla's `mirrored_wargoal` block (vanilla line 112).
- `common/war_goal_types/03_conquer_state.txt:58` retains the old infamy formula, while vanilla `:62` uses `state_infamy_value` and `:101` defines mirroring.
- `common/war_goal_types/27_unification.txt` lacks vanilla's mirroring block (vanilla line 60).

## Expected behavior and correction
Reconcile intentional mod behavior with mid-war enforcement, mirrored objectives and current infamy calculations. Review each goal and its consumers individually; preserve the initial 1776 American conflict and country setup.

## Testing and acceptance
- [ ] Three-goal comparison explains every retained deviation.
- [ ] New 1776 game: American Revolution and another representative conflict can start, progress and conclude.
- [ ] Observe mid-war state/subject transfer, mirror goals, re-taking objectives, infamy, participants/fronts and peace results where applicable.
- [ ] Compare with #20 and explicitly record any untested branches; approved/integrated changes where applicable before Done.

## Delivery safeguards
Use `hotfix/1.15`. Preserve the dirty local workspace, historical map work (#18) and Yekatarina's law audit (#17). Do not merge into main without explicit authorization. Static success is not runtime acceptance. General implementation is queued behind the initial #20 runtime comparison; planning this task does not authorize a bulk migration.

Evidence: [initial assessment](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_INITIAL_ASSESSMENT_2026_11_06.md), local Victoria 3 `1.15.0 / 6338547985`, compared with the canonical read-only game files. No full modded first-day test has yet been accepted.

pr.title: [1.15 Hotfix] Port war support/events and journals; fix naval AI/northern passability
pr.body:
## Problem and resulting behavior
Four event calls also retained the removed war-exhaustion API; they now use native signed support changes, with the associated level gates calibrated to 1.15 (#28).

The old full-file defines mask also retained the 1.13.9 war-support model. This branch now exposes native **1.15 support/peace settings** and retains only the proven 1776 scenario and demographic overrides (#26). The start date, 0.30 base working-adult ratio and existing birth/mortality formulas are preserved.

Victoria 3 1.15 rejects legacy journal conclusion fields. This branch migrates two bounded batches to scripted outcomes: the original six files in #27, followed by the explicitly requested Sick Man of Europe continuation in `00_sick_man.txt`. Together these are **16 journals in 7 gameplay files, with 48 legacy fields replaced by 32 outcomes**. Authored criteria, effects, scopes and cleanup are retained.

The branch also includes the bounded Russian Northern Norway passability correction (#37), the locally accepted naval AI unpause-crash correction (#36) and two approved native copper-icon references (#33/#23). The crash investigation is not reopened. No map overhaul, law-audit change, copper redistribution, country-setup change or main merge is included.

Refs #28/#21 (event APIs), #26/#21 (war support), #27/#24 (journals), #36 (accepted locally), #20/#19 (baseline/coordination), #33/#23 (icons). No automatic issue closure.

## Native war support and narrow scenario defines — #26
**PASS_RUNTIME_USER_VALIDATED — accepted 2026-11-08.** The maintainer reports completing the detailed #26 protocol with all checks passing and authorizes closing the mission. [Scoped confirmation](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/issues/26#issuecomment-6714512887). This does not certify other issues or authorize a main merge.

Commit [9f9df1e](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/9f9df1ee0a5724e61787de241578e5544cd60a2d) removes `common/defines/00_defines.txt` and adds `zz_1776_scenario.txt`. Provenance reconstructs the old native baseline and identifies the later authored demographic changes. All **1,836 old/current primary keys are mapped**; the override keeps 18 effective scenario/demographic fields and no warfare coefficients.

- Native 0–100 range, drift toward 50, current initialization floors, low-support effects, enforcement and eligible-war stalemate mechanics are inherited. Old negative support, exhaustion and automatic-capitulation keys are removed.
- Local and isolated remote-candidate audits: **1,732 / 1,732 each**. All **nine negative controls** are detected. The published read-only audit also runs with its compact authored contract, without private input captures.
- Installed in the regular local mod used by active playset **hhhh**. The maintainer has now accepted the detailed engine protocol. The agent did not perform a new engine run; test build, measurements and conditional fixtures were not separately reported.
- Map, Russia/Cossack, technology/economy and SERG/WORLD work are preserved. One observed concurrent Russian-law edit is retained locally and excluded from this commit. No local Git metadata or vanilla writes.
- At the maintainer's additional request, only the French expansion **group label** becomes **Guerres napoléoniennes / Napoleonic Wars**. Its natural-borders entry retains its own title and mechanics. Two dedicated UTF-8-BOM localization overrides are included.
- Twelve added files read back exactly; the commit changes only those twelve paths and the removed old mask. Unrelated branch content is inherited from the previous head.

[Mapping and preservation report](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE26_WAR_SUPPORT_2026_11_07/REPORT.md) · [Runtime protocol](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE26_WAR_SUPPORT_2026_11_07/RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md) · [Validation](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE26_WAR_SUPPORT_2026_11_07/VALIDATION.json).

#26 is accepted following the maintainer's overall protocol-pass confirmation and is closed as completed / Done. Native special-war exceptions remain part of the protocol. #28/#29/#32, the remaining journal inventory and the later Ottoman-visibility/Russian-religion local follow-up are outside this scoped acceptance.

## Event support-change API migration — #28
**IMPLEMENTED_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION**, commit [68cd4c7](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/68cd4c75c49c041c3890c33585443973d4ccc6db). Two event files retain the intended political/war behavior using the current native 1.15 API.

- Four obsolete calls migrated: the two effects in `revolution_pulse1_events.2` now use `add_war_support_change = { target = ROOT value = -5 }`; both electoral eligibility/selection predicates in `election_contextual_events.3` now use `has_war_support_change = { target = ROOT value < -5 }`.
- Two directly related revolutionary support-level gates move from `< 10` to native `< 55`, preserving the old eligibility band after the range change. Change and level are treated separately.
- War scopes, `ROOT` recipients, attacking-war-leader checks, random weights, civil-war/morale consequences, parties, cooldowns and unrelated events are preserved. The functional diff is **two files / eleven replaced lines**.
- **38/38 local checks and 38/38 remote-candidate checks pass; all ten negative controls are detected.** Boundary fixtures distinguish exactly −5 from smaller changes and exactly 55 from lower levels.
- All other tokens in the two files are preserved. No removed exhaustion call remains in mod `events/` or `common/`. **2,487 other captured functional/tracking files** retain their hashes; native and local Git metadata are unchanged.
- Already installed in the regular local mod. Eight published files read back exactly, and the commit's path list matches the bounded bundle. **No #28 engine test has been performed**; issue stays open for maintainer testing.

[Six-site mapping and report](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE28_WAR_SUPPORT_EVENTS_2026_11_08/REPORT.md) · [Targeted runtime protocol](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE28_WAR_SUPPORT_EVENTS_2026_11_08/RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md) · [Static validation](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE28_WAR_SUPPORT_EVENTS_2026_11_08/VALIDATION.json).

## Northern Norway passability — #37
Commit [6d2d9f7](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/6d2d9f7684f1c5618b9c17ec6e558b44b6f7deab) removes four inherited impassable IDs from the existing Russian part of `STATE_NORTHERN_NORWAY` (`map_data/state_regions/00_west_europe.txt:177`). Those four owned/populated provinces were all blocked. **One gameplay line changes; 33 other impassables, borders, ownership, population, terrain, hubs and resources are preserved.**

Installed directly in the regular local mod/playset **hhhh**. Static audit passes: 133 provinces with complete unique ownership, Russian passable count 0 → 4, unchanged DENNOR count, unique strategic region, and pixel-edge paths to Kola. 1,089 protected local files retain their hashes. Four committed files read back exactly; remote gameplay comparison is one line. [Evidence and runtime protocol](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE37_NORTHERN_NORWAY_2026_11_07.md).

This is a confirmed configuration defect; introduction by 1.15 is unproven. Engine rendering/movement, neighboring impassables and save/reload still require in-game acceptance. #37 remains open.

## Journal changes
- First batch, commit [1b94162](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/1b9416263775c56e607c86af9fbbe490feef7077): USA French support, revolutionary spirit, Ottoman reforms, imperial centralization, imperial situation/vote and birth-quota trial. **8 journals / 22 legacy fields → 15 outcomes**; 14 original predicates and every effect body retained.
- Sick Man continuation, commit [2f06ad3](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/2f06ad31c9fac166a7316b67f19bcdd576d9a10d): **8 journals / 26 legacy fields → 17 outcomes**, in one gameplay file. Preserve 16 predicates, ten effect bodies/order, four required reforms and the **10,950-day** deadline. Main timeout has no trigger and uses the native timeout flag/presentation; seven invalidations stay silent.
- Non-conclusion behavior remains token-equivalent: activation, immediate/pulses, modifiers, progress bars, thresholds, buttons/widgets, transfer/inheritance flags, variables, event lists and DLC gates.
- The first batch's orphan Ottoman invalidation handler retains a dormant hidden outcome (`always = no`); no new condition is invented. Sick Man retains original ownership/subject checks, strict separatism thresholds and existing cultural/bureaucracy cleanup.

[First-batch mapping and tests](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE27_JOURNAL_BATCH1_2026_11_06.md) · [Sick Man mapping and runtime protocol](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE27_SICK_MAN_2026_11_07.md) · [Sick Man validation](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE27_SICK_MAN_VALIDATION_2026_11_07.json).

## Local delivery
**The journal batches, #26 defines correction and requested group label are installed in the regular local mod used by active playset `hhhh`.** Read-only launcher verification confirms the path; no extra registered copy or playset switch is needed. The previous remote-only delivery statements in the dated November 6 report describe an earlier stage.

The installation preserved all pre-existing local status entries and accepted naval files, backed up source bytes and avoided checkout/reset/local Git metadata writes. Only the approved copper icon references were installed; resource distribution, capacity, recipes and yields are unchanged.

## Validation
- Installed Sick Man audit: **PASS_STATIC_ONLY**, 8 journals / 17 outcomes / zero errors; all ten negative controls detected.
- Installed first-batch regression audit: **PASS_STATIC_ONLY**, 8 journals / 15 outcomes / zero errors; its original eight negative controls are documented separately.
- All nine standard/timeout localization keys resolve in native English/French. No new player-facing prose.
- Four new/extended files read back exactly at the Sick Man commit. The scoped commit changes one gameplay file, the reusable read-only audit and two evidence files.
- Remaining inventory: **1,425 direct legacy fields in 170 other journal files**; not a bug count. Eastern Crisis continuation and other initialization/scope debt remain outside these bounded batches.
- Naval correction: 25 category lines in three files, accepted locally by the maintainer.
- Copper icons still require visual acceptance. No new game run or Paradox parser test is claimed for this journal delivery.

## Acceptance before integration
- [ ] #28: exercise both revolutionary effect sites and both electoral condition/selection sites, including sign/boundary, multi-war targeting, save/reload and fresh logs.
- [x] Detailed #26 engine protocol accepted by the maintainer on 2026-11-08: initialization, support/peace behavior and eligible cases, save/reload and logs as covered by that protocol. The broader #22 workstream is not closed by this receipt.
- [x] Expansion-group heading and preserved natural-borders title accepted as part of the #26 protocol; the test language was not separately specified.
- [ ] Human review of both bounded mappings, the dormant Ottoman cleanup choice and the four-province passability patch.
- [ ] Fresh Russia game: inspect the Russian Northern Norway state part, test land movement where permitted, adjacent intended impassables and save/reload (#37).
- [ ] Fresh 1776 USA, Ottoman and imperial sessions; inspect all affected entries and the birth-quota trial where available.
- [ ] Exercise every Sick Man reform, main success/timeout, separatism failure, invalidation and modifier/culture cleanup; confirm one application of counters/events.
- [ ] Test simultaneous predicates, the exact timeout boundary, forced removal and relevant DLC branches; record Eastern Crisis dependency failures separately.
- [ ] Save/reload active and concluded entries, advance again and compare all rotated parser/runtime logs with #20.
- [ ] Validate the final combined branch and copper icons; obtain runtime acceptance and explicit integration authorization.

PR remains **draft**, #27 remains **open**, and neither is Done. The last verified #27 status was In review with this PR linked. #26 is now accepted by the maintainer following the detailed engine protocol and may be Done. This is human-reported acceptance; prior static receipts remain static evidence. #20/#25 remain open. #37 is tracked under map parent #24; its four-province configuration defect is corrected, with visual/gameplay acceptance pending.
